message.content: Fusion research has long been tied to the promise of clean energy, but its benefits extend much further than power generation. Scientists developing fusion devices created advanced materials that can withstand extreme heat and radiation. These materials now serve in medical equipment and industrial applications. Plasma physics research has significantly improved our understanding of stellar processes and space weather. The iritic challenge of controlling plasma led to important innovations in magnetic confinement technology. Accelerators built for fusion studies are now widely used in cancer treatment. Superconducting magnets from tokamak projects found applications in MRI machines and particle physics.
